notes: Names without suffix on the sheet (FINDLAY, PROVIDENCE, LOGAN, CAMPBELL, ELM, ELDER, GREEN, OLIVER, LIVINGSTON, POPLAR) recorded as '... Street'; W. PLUM / E. PLUM are the canal-bank streets either side of the Miami Canal (80'). E-W streets west of the canal (Oliver east leg, Liberty) run ESE. Findlay crosses the canal on a skewed bridge (W. Plum end lower than E. Plum end). Three unnamed 12' alleys open off the east side of Providence: y~1098 and y~3976 run through to West Plum; y~2002 is a dead end. Holenshade Alley (no width printed, ~12 ft drawn) runs north from Oliver and dead-ends. Campbell (20') runs Findlay to Dick Alley. Green west of Elm (y~5161) and east of Elm (y~5695) are offset. A further ~15 ft gap in the Volume 1 outlines south of Liberty at x~5330 (unnamed, probably an alley) is not recorded as an intersection.
